text: I came here because it's close to home, but this will probably be my last time. The first time I went was last year. I booked an appointment for fillings; two teeth were cracked, and I could feel it. But the dentist just tapped on my teeth, both the cracked and the healthy ones, asking if I felt the same thing. He tapped for a very long time. Finally, he made me get an X-ray, but even after reviewing the film, he kept tapping. He eventually told me he couldn't do it and I had to go somewhere else. I wasted 200 baht on the X-ray. The next day, I booked an appointment at another clinic, and the dentist there filled my teeth right away. They also took an X-ray for my molar, but after reviewing the film, they were able to do it too. I think the dentist was inexperienced and not very skilled, but I still gave him a chance. Just a few days ago, I even went for a tartar removal. I thought it would be a simple, basic tartar removal, but the dentist did it in less than 5 minutes! My teeth looked terrible; I hadn't had tartar removed in over a year. When I went for the fillings, the dentist said I had a lot of tartar and needed removing it. When it actually happened, it was like he didn't even bother to remove it; it was more like using dental floss at home. The bill was 1,040 baht, plus a 40 baht charge for sterilization equipment that I didn't even use. It was probably the doctor's job, but they charged everyone. At this price, we think it's expensive. If it were expensive but the service was good, we wouldn't mind. We feel like we wasted our money. While waiting, other people waited for about the same amount of time, maybe even less than a minute. We probably won't give them a third chance.
